about_the_game:
About This Game

Welcome to Leonardo da Vinci’s workshop! Find 500 adorable cats hidden across 5 unique maps and bring this artistic world to life by coloring them by numbers!

Each map is filled with hand-drawn details inspired by Da Vinci’s inventions, sketches, and masterful designs. Can you discover the cats hidden in this historic and artistic atmosphere?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Revive the workshop with the relaxing power of art and colors!

✨ Features:

🌟 5 detailed and unique Da Vinci workshop maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxing gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
